mentions.name: Tell Me a Penguin
mentions.description: An endless mad libs game where you generate silly stories about whatever you want, keep writing more chapters for good stories, and share stories back and forth with family (kids, grandparents) to stay in touch. Currently in testing.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://tellmeapenguin.com (Close! Come help test it) - Endless mad libs about whatever you want, and if it's a good story, you can keep writing more chapters. The kiddos love it, and you can share back and forth with grandparents and whatnot to keep sillily in touch.
